pdf_script = '''
import pymupdf
from docx import Document

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all paragraph text
lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

# Create PDF with pymupdf
pdf = pymupdf.open()
# Use A4 page size
width, height = 595.28, 841.89
margin = 50
y = margin
fontsize_title = 16
fontsize_normal = 10
line_height_title = 22
line_height_normal = 14
max_width = width - 2 * margin

page = pdf.new_page(width=width, height=height)

for line in lines:
    # Determine if this is a title/heading line
    is_title = line in ["Customer Activity Report"]
    fs = fontsize_title if is_title else fontsize_normal
    lh = line_height_title if is_title else line_height_normal
    font = "helv"

    # Wrap long lines
    words = line.split()
    current_line = ""
    wrapped_lines = []
    for word in words:
        test = current_line + (" " if current_line else "") + word
        tw = pymupdf.get_text_length(test, fontname=font, fontsize=fs)
        if tw > max_width and current_line:
            wrapped_lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
        else:
            current_line = test
    if current_line:
        wrapped_lines.append(current_line)

    for wl in wrapped_lines:
        if y + lh > height - margin:
            page = pdf.new_page(width=width, height=height)
            y = margin
        page.insert_text((margin, y), wl, fontname=font, fontsize=fs)
        y += lh

    # Extra spacing after title
    if is_title:
        y += 10

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully")
'''
